entities.summary: Abdulkarim Abubakar Kana is a Nigerian Professor of Law from Nasarawa State University Keffi and former dean of the Faculty of law. He is the current Nasarawa State Attorney General and Commissioner for Justice, a member of the Nigerian Bar Association and the founder of Kana & Co Law firm.
